page.layout: One page: a yellow leaf or board photographed within a dark frame, with only manuscript annotations in pencil and ink, no printed text.
page.notes: The page carries no printed text. It shows handwritten annotations only: a pencilled shelf-type mark at upper left with a line and cross, a small note at upper right cut off by the edge, and a handwritten list in the centre under the headings "Plates" and "Portraits" with names such as Charles V, Philip II, Margaret of Austria, and Duke of Alva. These are manuscript marks, not printed matter, so they are left out.
